scope: Prospective installed-API software/numerical diagnostic on synthetic independent observations. All criteria share the same 600 response vectors; not 1800 independent cohorts. Null counts are descriptive, with intervals conditional on a shared reference. Unequal-variance stress deliberately violates the Gaussian model. This is not clinical, FDR, NB or interval qualification and not model-agent performance.
replay: Repeat every case with the same pinned environment, sources, inputs, seeds and options in a fresh output directory. Compare full result JSON exactly; elapsed times, DAG run IDs and wall-clock timestamps are separately recorded infrastructure fields.
